LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.0.label: Into the Rift
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.0.descript: Requires Blink learned from its augment card. Retains the original range and cooldown. Unlocking this tree neither teaches nor casts Blink.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.1.label: Landing Edge
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.1.descript: After successfully casting Blink, store one follow-up for 5 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage. Store at most one, with an 8-second creation cooldown. Failed casts and other movement do not trigger it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.2.label: Landing Veil
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.2.descript: After successfully casting Blink, gain a separate 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Failed casts grant no shield. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.3.label: Rift Sweep
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.3.descript: After Landing Edge deals bonus damage, strike one other enemy within 3 cells of the impact and clear sight for 25 damage, once per 8 seconds. It cannot hit the original target again. Base rewards: damage 25.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.4.label: Advance Cover
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.4.descript: After Landing Edge deals bonus damage, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight a 50-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.5.label: Blink Rescue
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.5.descript: After successfully casting Blink, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of your landing and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. Healthy allies, missing parts and permanent scars grant no healing. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.6.label: Shared Landing
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Blink013.nodes.6.descript: After successfully casting Blink, grant the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of your landing and clear sight a 25-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 25.
